line_items.description: Executive Lounge Day Pass - Quiet Video-Call Booth (Half Day)
Minibar: Organic Truffle Cashews & Bio Mate Kola
Overnight Secure Courtyard Parking w/ EV Charging

reasoning: Hotel folio for two weekday nights in Berlin. The Tier 2 room cap limits each EUR 175.00 room charge to EUR 160.00. AI Summit Berlin is not a listed trade-fair override. The executive-lounge pass is an optional premium hotel amenity, not rented business workspace, and is deducted even though it was used for a client call. The minibar is deducted. Parking is deducted because the note does not identify a rental or pool vehicle. City tax is reimbursed in full, and VAT is limited to 7% of the eligible EUR 320.00 room amount, or EUR 22.40. Total reimbursement is EUR 357.40.
